That ValueError happens because NumPy generates special integer types (np.int64) that the table component doesn't automatically recognize as standard JSON types.
To fix it, just cast the values to standard Python integers (int) so the table can read them cleanly. Update your cell with this version:
import numpy as np

def get_node_matrix():
    # Convert numpy ints to standard Python ints for JSON compatibility
    arr = np.random.randint(1, 10, size=(3, 3))
    return [[int(x) for x in row] for row in arr]

matrix_data = get_node_matrix()
spatial_grid = mo.ui.table(matrix_data)
spatial_grid

Run that cell, and your spatial grid will render right away!
